description: Lets the Raven page served by the bundled Go server (http://127.0.0.1:<port>, the origin src/lib.rs navigates to; the port is 8090 unless that was taken at launch, hence the wildcard) use native notifications. WKWebView has no web Notification permission prompt, so the page calls window.__TAURI__.notification instead. It may also set the window theme (so the native title bar follows the page's light/dark mode), drag/zoom the window from the page-drawn macOS title bar, and tell the app which icon style and appearance to show (set_app_icon). It may also open http(s), mailto and tel links in the system browser: tauri-plugin-shell injects a click handler that sends every <a target="_blank"> click to shell|open and cancels the click, so without shell:allow-open those links (calendar Join meeting, invite cards) do nothing. Nothing else is exposed to the remote page.
